summary: @servicetitan/hash-browser-router preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute obfuscated sibling payload
details: The package declares a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime binary from the oven-sh GitHub releases (or reuses an existing `bun` if present), makes it executable, and uses it to run a 727,680-byte sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a single-line, heavily obfuscated script (obfuscator.io-style string-array rotation via a `WV8StW` push/shift routine over a large numeric literal array `n7gIxM=[...]`, hex-mangled identifiers, `// @bun @bun-cjs` header) that is not referenced by the package's advertised `main` (`dist/index.js`) and is only reachable through the preinstall dropper. Execution happens under a freshly downloaded alternate runtime (Bun) rather than Node, so Node-based tooling never observes the payload. The advertised functionality of the package is a React hash-based router, which has no legitimate need to fetch a second language runtime at install and hand it an opaque, obfuscated script.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
